verdict.rationale: Lium documents API keys with scopes set at creation and per-key daily, monthly and lifetime USD budgets enforced by the server, which covers the credential- and spend-control half of the story. The evidence never mentions team members, organizations or role-based access. Missing for 10: team/member management, role assignment, independent or hands-on corroboration of scoped keys and budget enforcement.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can manage team members with roles and scoped API keys so credentials and spend stay controlled

citations.quote: API keys with scopes and per-key daily, monthly and lifetime USD budgets enforced by the server
Scopes limit what a key can do. They are set when you create the key and can't be changed later.
